animations.name: Light Punch Jump
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied mid-air tucked jump pose. Perform ONE SINGLE crisp Rock-Howard-style Fatal Fury jumping light punch across the clip (one punch only, never twice), pure body motion in completely empty air: staying suspended at the EXACT same mid-air height in the upper-center of the canvas with knees tucked (NEVER fall down or land on the ground), Oscar coils his front shoulder slightly back in brief mid-air anticipation; then he snaps ONE quick, sharp straight lead jab angled slightly forward-and-downward (~25 degrees) to the right while keeping his rear fist tucked tightly in guard near his chin; brief clean apex, then smooth retraction back into the exact starting tucked mid-air jump guard pose. Keep entire body inside 512x512 with wide margin. Preserve Oscar's face, solid black outfit, sneakers, scale and pixel art. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
